response:
Digital assets are defined as digital technology products created, issued, transferred, and authenticated using blockchain technology. They include security tokens (encrypted securities assets), payment tokens, utility tokens, and mixed tokens combining these types. Their valuation and property rights are governed by civil and relevant laws. The Ministry of Finance oversees regulations related to these assets.
